note: Manufacturer (own plant, coconut-shell steam activated carbon, Kerala) — not a trader. Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code (Sudan, Russia, plus Saudi Arabia/Belgium counterparties), latest 2026-02-23 — this is a real shipper, not a website claim. Domestic (India) supply: no GST turnover band, tender or contract evidence obtained; registries were blocked and search was down, so this is an evidence gap, not a negative finding — do not read it as 'no domestic supplies'. No sanctions/court/insolvency screening performed in this role (shipments evidence only); no indication of liquidation or strike-off seen. Verdict: accepted, manufacturer, HS confirmed as declared.
